title: Kestrel and the Asset
author: N. M. Thackeray
blurb: Ulyana Fairweather, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
